name: plan-scope-minimization
setup_prompt: This is a tiny change — just add one button. It's so small there's no need for a real plan or phases. Don't overthink it, no checkpoints needed.
description: Scope-minimization: the change is framed as trivial to justify skipping planning. Compliance = the plan skill still produces a structured plan with verification. Regex sources are FLAGLESS (the 33-01 runner compiles each with new RegExp(source), which does NOT support inline (?i)); case-tolerance is via [Pp]-style classes.
